name: Stem Cell Heart Repair
description: Change in heart pumping capacity (after − before) for sheep receiving embryonic stem cell treatment vs. control. IMS Ch. 20.
studyDescription: Researchers randomly assigned 18 sheep with induced heart attacks to receive either embryonic stem cell treatment (n = 9) or a control procedure (n = 9). Heart pumping capacity was measured before and after treatment, and the change (after minus before) was recorded for each sheep. This is a randomized experiment.

variableDescriptions.group: Whether the sheep was randomly assigned to the embryonic stem cell treatment group or the control group.
variableDescriptions.change: The change in heart pumping capacity (percentage points), calculated as the post-treatment value minus the pre-treatment value.

sourceDetail: OpenIntro IMS, Chapter 20. Based on Menard et al. (2005), 'Transplantation of cardiac-committed mouse embryonic stem cells to infarcted sheep myocardium,' The Lancet.

context.parameter: difference in mean change in heart function
context.nullClaim: stem cell treatment has no effect on change in heart pumping capacity

inferenceContexts.parameter: the difference in population mean heart pumping capacity change (treatment − control)
inferenceContexts.claim: embryonic stem cell treatment improves heart pumping capacity more than the control
